inputs.original_text: Nigeria’s democracy is undergoing an alarming, largely underexamined transformation: political parties that were meant to represent people and serve the public are increasingly becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy. Developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections make this trend clear.
inputs.modified_text: Nigeria’s parties are being turned into gated clubs, and the APC’s moves ahead of the 2027 elections look less like a political evolution than a deliberate way to keep ordinary people out of decisions that affect them. Calling this “underexamined” only makes the silence more suspicious: when wealth becomes the price of influence, the public loses its voice while powerful interests tighten their grip.
